hero.headline: Our
hero.description: A complete portfolio of industrial-grade hardware, software platforms, and managed services — all designed and built in-house at our Bangalore R&D centre.

hardwareSection.heading: Invendis
hardwareSection.description: Rugged, industrial-grade devices designed for reliability in demanding field environments.

hardwareProducts.title: iSense RMS Controller
hardwareProducts.desc: The heart of Invendis's telecom monitoring. Dual SIM, multi-protocol, modular design with 5G-ready architecture and pluggable RS485 cards.

hardwareProducts.title: Multi-Function Energy Meters
hardwareProducts.desc: Tariff-grade smart meters for utility billing and industrial energy monitoring. Compatible with major DIN standards.

hardwareProducts.title: Smart ATS Controller
hardwareProducts.desc: Generator ATS control unit with digital output control, auto-switching logic, and remote visibility via RMS platform.

hardwareProducts.title: Telecom Gateways
hardwareProducts.desc: Packaged telecom site gateway solutions integrating monitoring, control, and communication in a single ruggedised enclosure.

hardwareProducts.title: GSM Energy Meter
hardwareProducts.desc: GSM-connected energy meter for remote monitoring of consumption at distributed utility and telecom sites.

hardwareProducts.title: Sensors & Accessories
hardwareProducts.desc: Surveillance cameras, environmental sensors, fuel sensors, BMS interfaces, and door/access control units for complete site visibility.

silboSection.heading: SILBO
silboSection.description: Industrial networking hardware for mission-critical industrial and telecom environments.
silboSection.intro: SILBO is Invendis's dedicated industrial networking brand — delivering rugged routers, gateways, protocol converters, and switches purpose-built for Industry 4.0 connectivity challenges.

silboProducts.title: Multi-WAN Router
silboProducts.desc: 4G/5G, Wi-Fi 4/5/6, and dual-SIM with load balancing and VPN support for secure industrial connectivity.

silboProducts.title: Industrial Gateway
silboProducts.desc: Edge computing gateways for data aggregation, local processing, and cloud connectivity at industrial sites.

silboProducts.title: Protocol Converter
silboProducts.desc: Modbus, DNP3, IEC, and SNMP protocol bridging for legacy equipment integration and industrial automation.

silboProducts.title: Network Switch
silboProducts.desc: Industrial managed and unmanaged Ethernet switches rated for -40°C to +75°C operating environments.

silboProducts.title: SD-WAN Gateway
silboProducts.desc: Software-defined WAN with centralised management, traffic prioritisation, and zero-touch provisioning.

silboProducts.title: Cloud NMS
silboProducts.desc: Centralised network management platform for monitoring, configuration, and troubleshooting SILBO devices remotely.

silboProducts.title: 4G Dongle
silboProducts.desc: Compact plug-and-play 4G dongle for rapid deployment of cellular connectivity at remote industrial sites.

silboProducts.title: Controllers
silboProducts.desc: Programmable industrial controllers for automation, digital I/O, and site equipment management.

softwareSection.heading: Software Agnostic
softwareSection.description: Cloud-based and on-premise platforms for monitoring, analytics, and operations management.

softwarePlatforms.title: PizGloria RMS Platform
softwarePlatforms.desc: Cloud-based Remote Monitoring System with graphical site views, executive dashboards, energy analytics, and Power BI integration. Deployed for telecom and solar customers globally.

softwarePlatforms.title: Mobile App
softwarePlatforms.desc: Field operations mobile application for real-time alarm acknowledgment, site visits, trouble ticketing, and manager-level executive views — iOS and Android.

softwarePlatforms.title: Utility Billing Platform
softwarePlatforms.desc: End-to-end energy utility billing solution with meter data management, tariff configuration, invoice generation, and customer portal.

softwarePlatforms.title: Alarm & Notification Engine
softwarePlatforms.desc: Automated escalation matrix delivering SMS, email, and push notifications based on configurable alarm thresholds and SLA windows.

softwarePlatforms.title: Analytics & Reporting
softwarePlatforms.desc: Backend analytics layer with customised algorithms for predictive maintenance, energy anomaly detection, and executive KPI reporting via Power BI.

softwarePlatforms.title: NMS – Network Management
softwarePlatforms.desc: Centralised network management system for SILBO devices, providing configuration management, performance monitoring, and fault management.

softwarePlatforms.title: Workforce Management Software
softwarePlatforms.desc: Centralized workforce management system for connected operations, providing workforce tracking, resource allocation, productivity monitoring, and real-time operational visibility.
